temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan likely believed Gary was dedicated and hardworking, though not fully aware of how severe the toll on Gary's health had become.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Ethan learns Gary's overwork is severe enough to threaten his health, and Gary's refusal shows he feels unable or unwilling to step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dangerously overcommitted to hospital work and resistant to taking a break, so Ethan's concern is justified.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and disappointed that Gary declines help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene and support Gary in improving his health, despite the initial refusal.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary admits things are complicated and says he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan remains worried that Gary is overworked and reluctant to take a break, but since they are at the retreat, he hopes Gary may relax and open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Ethan shifts from suspecting mainly work overload to suspecting deeper, unshared personal problems behind Gary's behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is carrying complicated burdens beyond ordinary job stress and has been hiding them to avoid burdening others.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and perhaps hurt or worried that Gary kept things from him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Gary to open up and assure him that he can help without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he faces. Ethan offers to help Gary prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities, and Gary agrees.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is hiding complicated pressures and needs support to share and address them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Ethan now understands the specific sources of Gary's stress and sees that Gary is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is explained by new-department pressure and personal challenges, and he can improve with practical support and better balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief and empathy, mixed with cautious hope.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary organize his schedule, prioritize tasks, and delegate responsibilities.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary and discusses his progress and remaining challenges. Gary reports feeling less overwhelmed and says he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has begun working toward better balance with support and can continue to improve.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary's reported progress confirms that the support is working and that Gary is making real efforts to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is on a positive path and making genuine progress toward a healthier work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue offering support and encouragement while Gary sustains his progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance, feels more in control, and credits Ethan's support. Ethan decides it is time to step back while still being available.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has improved substantially but may still benefit from encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—seeing Gary manage independently confirms that Gary no longer needs active intervention and that Ethan can step back.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a sustainable, healthy balance and can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied, happy for Gary, proud, and relieved.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support but remain available if Gary ever needs him.
